clocks.machine: b.anim: advances only while working, already includes brownout speed
clocks.generator: simulation time gated by b.genOn; freeze when paused
clocks.progress: actual interpolated recipe progress, never the animation frame index
clocks.event: existing completion/delivery event; do not emit continuously
clocks.reducedMotion: retain working-machine motion and night emissions; suppress decorative camera motion, particles and celebrations

Splitter.animation: existing delivery/status event only; no invented moving mechanism

Converger.animation: existing delivery/status event only; no invented moving mechanism

Terminal.animation: existing delivery/status event only; no invented moving mechanism

Depot.animation: existing delivery/status event only; no invented moving mechanism

Crossover.map: Layer a straight under-belt and its cargo, a bridge deck and tread, then over-belt cargo. Do not use this menu icon as a map tile.
Crossover.animation: existing delivery/status event only; no invented moving mechanism
